newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5475/5495 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous 42.5470/5490, dealers said.
Dealers said there was not much activity in the market ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend.
"Banks were busy in squaring their positions. There were only a few deals," said one dealer with a state-owned bank.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.25 percent to 5.25 percent, down from the previous 4.5 percent to 6.0 percent, the dealers said.
